verdict.rationale: Canny's own docs say Autopilot automatically captures feedback from support, sales, and review platforms. They name Gong (sales), Intercom (support/chat) and Slack (chat), and directory entries describe capture from Fathom and Fireflies sales-call transcripts. Missing for 10: detailed per-integration documentation for support and chat tools such as Intercom and Slack (evidence is mostly marketing-level one-liners), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect feedback capture to support, sales, and chat tools I already use

citations.quote: Automatically capture feedback from Gong, Intercom, Slack, and dozens of other sources
